request.raw_text: Remove the collision between handle and cofeepot.

areas_to_change.action: Eliminate geometric interference by repositioning or locally reshaping the handle to provide clearance.
areas_to_change.reference_geometry: The black handle and the coffee-pot body.
areas_to_change.location: At the portions of the handle that overlap or penetrate the coffee-pot body, visible near the pot within the enclosure.
areas_to_change.description: Modify the handle-to-pot interface so the handle remains associated with the coffee pot but does not occupy the same solid volume. Maintain a practical clearance and retain intentional attachment regions.

areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve the pot's overall profile, capacity, opening, lid region, and placement within the surrounding enclosure unless a minor local relief is required.
Preserve the recognizable grip shape, usable grasping space, and intentional mounting connection to the coffee pot while removing only unintended interference.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Outer appliance enclosure and support structure
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Keep the housing, side walls, external support or carrying bracket, and their current placement unchanged.

areas_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Electrical cord, plug, feet, and other accessories
areas_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve their geometry, routing, and assembly positions.

predicted_final_outcome.geometry: The handle and coffee-pot body will be separated by a small nonzero clearance everywhere except at deliberate attachment or mounting interfaces.
predicted_final_outcome.function: The coffee pot will retain a usable handle for gripping and removal without interference from the pot body.
predicted_final_outcome.behavior: The handle will no longer penetrate or collide with the coffee pot during static assembly or intended handling, while remaining securely connected.

ambiguities.description: The model contains more than one black handle-like or bracket-like feature, so the referenced handle is not uniquely identified from the wording alone.
candidate_interpretations: The handle attached directly to the coffee pot inside the enclosure.
The large external U-shaped carrying handle or support surrounding the appliance.

ambiguities.description: The request does not prescribe which component should be edited or the required clearance.
candidate_interpretations: Move or offset the handle away from the coffee-pot surface.
Reshape the handle locally while retaining its mounts.
Add a local recess to the coffee-pot body.
Apply coordinated minor changes to both components with a practical manufacturing clearance.
